notes.title: Update from July 9
notes.content: - This update will be especially relevant for old players. In order to optimize the transportation of cargo and landing troops between planets, now when you launch a spaceship, automatic switching between planets does not occur. So, for example, you can first send several cargo or landing ships to a certain planet at once and only then switch to the selected planet.

notes.title: Update from May 11
notes.content:
- The number of nuclear missiles available for construction is now limited. One player on one planet at a time can have no more than 10 missiles. If at the time of the update there were already more than 10 missiles, then the extra ones should be dismantled, otherwise the launch will be blocked. Dismantling of extra missiles occurs instantly, and all resources spent on construction are returned in full.
- When the hub is destroyed, now not only part of the influence is lost, but also part of the resources.
- Non-combat units (workers, spies, scouts, etc.), if they have the auto-attack function disabled, are now not the first to aggro on red players' units.
- Fixed several bugs, plus minor edits.

notes.title: Update from March 30
notes.content:
To make the game more dynamic at the early stages, the following changes are introduced:
- The speed of construction of all buildings and fences has been increased by 2 times.
- The speed of resource collection by workers has been increased by 2 times.
- The amount of resources in open deposits has been increased by 1.5 times (berries, trees, anthills, all open deposits on the surface).
- The construction time of some units has been reduced.
- The movement speed of all ships, tanks and amphibians has been significantly increased.

Other changes:
- Switching the market mode between local and global now affects all markets simultaneously.
- The keys '<','>' (less/more) can be used to select the previous/next unit without switching the camera focus.
- Hot keys 'H','M','L' for the hub, market, laboratory.
- The author of the last message in the chat can delete it. It is also now possible to delete the last message in the system chat, or completely clear the system chat.
- Anti-ship mines now slightly open the fog of war.
- The quality of the fog of war has been slightly improved.
- Spaceships now require less iron, but significantly more titanium to build.
- If a unit is blown up by a mine, the player receives a message in the system chat, the owner of the mine is not indicated in this message.

notes.title: Update from March 16
notes.content:
Change in the rules:
- In order to slightly limit the number of planets colonized by one player, so that one top player cannot capture the entire galaxy, and to stimulate the fight against crime and illegals, a new rule is introduced into the game. Now, if you already have 10 colonized planets, then each new additional planet gives a penalty of -1% to the mining productivity for all colonies on all your planets. For example, if you have 30 planets, then the total penalty will be: -1%*(30-10) = -20%.

Changes in the market:
- The tax on the market is no longer fixed, and the transaction now requires some time for delivery.
- The minimum tax on a transaction is 10%, the minimum delivery time is 30 seconds.
- For the local market, the further the market building is from the center of the map, the greater the tax and delivery time.
- For the global market, the tax and delivery time depend on the distance of the planet from the Earth, the further, the greater.

Mines:
- Mines now work on any units except yours, including units of peaceful players.
- On the screen, mines of other players, even peaceful ones, are now displayed in red, and they can be attacked, this is not considered criminal.
- Now, when a mine is fully installed and underground, it does not receive damage from explosions. Thus, it is now possible to plant several mines in a row, and this will not lead to a chain reaction.

Other changes:
- Street lights can now be turned on/off.
- Many buildings have their view radius reduced from 20 to 15.
- Hubs and towers have their view radius and armor increased.
- Tower HP increased from 5000 to 8000.
- Increased armor bonus for level 2 and 3 paints.
- Increased armor and damage of colored spiders.
- Now if you select a unit on the screen with the middle mouse button instead of the left one, all units of the selected type that are currently on the screen will be selected.
- You can also now quickly load/unload a cargo ship with a resource of a specific type with the middle mouse button.

notes.title: Update from February 25
notes.content:
- The list of spaceports in the Galaxy Map window can now be sorted. Left-clicking on the arrow buttons moves the selected spaceport up/down one position, right-clicking moves it to the beginning/end of the list. A spaceship from another planet will land on the first free spaceport from this list.

- The information panel now displays the index of the selected unit in brackets after the name of the unit, plus two new buttons for selecting units of the same type with the previous/next index. And middle-clicking on the information panel now selects all units of this type. That is, now, for example, you can close all the gates on the planet in just three clicks. To do this, click any gate on the map to select it, then middle-click on the information panel, and last click on the button with the lock.

- There are five new buttons on the panel with the Minimap.
(H)(M)(L) - buttons for quick access to the Hub, Market and Laboratory respectively. Left click selects the first/next object, right click selects the last/previous, middle click selects all objects of this type.
(<)(>) - buttons for selecting the previous/next selection.

notes.title: Updated February 12
notes.content:
New unit - Submarine:
- When underwater, the submarine cannot attack and does not receive damage itself, this allows it to safely approach dreadnoughts and pass through narrow passages protected by towers.
- When submerged, the submarine's viewing radius is halved, and its speed is reduced to 4.3 km/h.
- You can only give the order to dive in places that are deep enough, and if the oxygen supply is more than 30%. The oxygen supply is enough for 10 minutes.
- Surfacing is possible at any time. When the oxygen supply is less than 5%, the submarine will surface automatically. When on the surface, the oxygen supply is gradually restored.
- Anti-ship mines work on a submarine regardless of whether it is underwater or not.
- A submarine can be built in a dock.

Spy satellite:
- The spy satellite now takes 24 hours to build and costs 50,000 energy.
- The spaceport with the satellite now dispels the fog of war and is highlighted on the minimap and visible to all players.
- You can only have one satellite on the planet at a time, the next one can only be built after the first one is launched. That is, now the satellite can only be launched once a day maximum, and other players will see how much is left until the launch.

Other changes:
- The geologist's search time for resources has been significantly reduced and now does not depend on the type of resource.
- The increase in maximum armor for all paint levels has been increased by +5.
- The radar increases the population by 2.
- The cost of a radar scan has been increased and is now equal to 1000 energy.
- The tax on the global market is now the same as on the local one and is 10%.
- The change in the price for a transaction on the local market has been reduced and is now 2%.
- The explosion from the destruction of a building now causes little damage, the stronger the building, the greater the damage.
- For spaceships requiring refueling, the "drain fuel tanks" button is now available.

Fixed bugs:
- Now if the illegal sends his units to the governor's monastery, he again receives refugee status.
- Fixed the price of the radar and mine at the military factory.
- Fixed a global market error.
- Other minor fixes.

notes.title: Update from January 17
notes.content:
- Workers can no longer repair units as before, only buildings.
- To repair vehicles and ships, a new building is introduced into the game  - the workshop.
- The principle of the workshop is the same as the hospital, you need to select one or a group of units and right-click on the workshop.
- The repair speed is 10 HP per minute, HP is restored simultaneously for all units in the workshop.
- To cancel the repair, you need to click on the icon of the corresponding unit.
- In order to be able to repair ships, the workshop must be located near the shore.

notes.title: Update from January 10
notes.content:
New unit - Radar.
- Radar is a land-based reconnaissance drone, has the largest viewing radius and the highest speed in the game.
- In addition, the radar has a special function: by spending 100 energy, you can temporarily increase its viewing radius by 25 for 10 seconds.
- The radar does not have its own weapons, so it can only ram at a distance of 1 cell.
- The radar can be built at the military factory. In addition to regular resources, its production also requires rare and very rare resources.

A small change in the rules:
- now, every illegal every minute reduces the influence of the governor by 5.

notes.title: Update from December 9
notes.content:
Nuclear weapons are now available in the game. Two new types of missiles, nuclear missiles and air defense missiles, can now be built at the spaceport launch pad.

- Nuclear weapons have enormous destructive power and their use is considered illegal. Any peaceful player who starts building a nuclear missile is declared a criminal and receives the status of invader or tyrant on this planet, depending on his previous status, and all other players receive a notification in the system chat about the start of building a nuclear missile.
- A nuclear missile is built in 24 hours, and a lot of uranium is required to build it.
- In addition, due to increased radiation, a nuclear missile is easy to detect with scanners, so the launch pad with a nuclear missile dispels the fog of war and is highlighted on the minimap, and all players can see it.
- Once the missile is built, a nuclear strike can be launched anywhere on the planet. To do this, select a spaceport with a missile, then specify a rally point near the intended strike site, and click the "launch" button.
- The power of a nuclear explosion is 20,000, radius 50.
- A nuclear explosion dispels the fog of war for all players for a while.
- Air defense missiles are used to protect against nuclear missiles, which are much cheaper and can be built in just 1 hour.
- Air defense missiles are triggered automatically and are guaranteed to intercept any nuclear missile if the location of the nuclear strike is within the interception radius of the air defense missile.
- The interception radius of air defense missiles is 150, which is 2 times greater than the supply radius of the hub, which allows you to guarantee the protection of the hub and all its adjacent buildings.

- The number of units inside the APC is now displayed as colored squares on its roof.
- The "unload all" button is now available for the hospital, monastery, APC, ferry, ark, cargo starship and descent starship.

notes.title: Update from November 21
notes.content:
New unit - Armored personnel carrier (APC).

- The APC is used for fast and safe transportation of infantry and mines over long distances, it has good armor and very high speed.
- Up to 8 units can be loaded inside the APC. To board units into an APC, select a group of them, then right-click on the APC.
- When an APC is destroyed, units inside lose 10% of their HP. If there were mines inside when it was destroyed, they all explode. The power of this explosion is proportional to the number of mines. In this case, all infantry inside are killed.
- The APC does not have its own weapons, so it can only ram at a distance of 1 cell.
- The APC can be built at the military factory. In addition to regular resources, its production also requires rare and very rare resources.

- The transport ship has been renamed to a ferry.
- Now, just like the APC, when a ferry with mines is destroyed, it also explodes.

notes.title: Update from November 11
notes.content: A new unit, the Amphibian, a lightly armored hovercraft, is available in the game. The main feature of the Amphibian is that it is the only unit in the game that can move both on land and on water. Among the disadvantages, it is worth noting the small range of view and attack, in addition, its production requires rare and very rare resources. The Amphibian can be built at the plant.

notes.title: Update from November 6
notes.content:
- New players no longer need to register themselves, a new account is automatically created for them with the same nickname as their Steam nickname. This nickname can be changed if desired, if you register directly in the game.
- The "auto-login" option is now available in the start menu, for new players it is active by default and they immediately and automatically start the game without entering a nickname and password.

notes.title: Update from September 3
notes.content:
- You can now build a spy satellite at the spaceport. Once launched into orbit, the satellite dispels the fog of war across the entire planet for 5 minutes. After 5 minutes, the fog of war does not immediately cover the planet, but begins to gradually thicken again. Thus, in total, there will be about 10 minutes to study the planet.

- Only the governor or tyrant have the right to build a satellite.

- A spy satellite cannot be sent to another planet, it can only be launched into orbit around the current planet. After launch, the satellite disappears, and a new one must be built to scan it again.

- Damage from the explosion of spaceships when destroying spaceports has been reduced by 2 times, and the explosion radius has been reduced by 3.

- The attack radius of towers has been reduced by 1, and the dreadnought upgrade increases the attack radius of the dreadnought by 2. This allows the dreadnought to attack towers from a distance of 17 without receiving damage in return.

notes.title: May 30 update
notes.content:
A new building, the laboratory, is now available in the game.

- In the laboratory reactor, you can mix some resources to transform them into others.
- By experimenting with different ingredients and proportions, you can notice certain patterns. Knowing these patterns, you can experimentally select the exact recipes for each specific resource.
- A recipe is considered perfect if the reaction produces only one resource without the admixture of stone, energy or other resources. Only in this case the laboratory works with maximum productivity.
- In the laboratory you can get any resources except food, wood and ants.
- Starting a reactor requires energy and at least one resource.
- The reaction time and the amount of output resources are proportional to the amount of input resources.

notes.title: May 5th update
notes.content:
- The rules have changed a bit, now when a refugee's residence permit ends, he receives a new semi-criminal status "illegal".
- The illegal is still considered a peaceful player and no other peaceful player except the governor has the right to attack him.
- If the governor declares war on an illegal, the illegal receives the status of an occupant, while the peace status of the governor is preserved.
- By sending their units to the governor's monastery, the illegal can at any time regain the peaceful status of a refugee.
- Now each occupant reduces the overall mining productivity of the planet by 5%, illegal by 10%, tyrant by 15%. Productivity penalties are cumulative, the more occupiers and illegals, the lower the overall mining productivity of the planet. Everyone gets fined, including the violators themselves.
- The cost of the hub has been increased. In addition, the construction of a level 11 and higher hub now requires very rare resources: platinum, silicon, obsidian and diamonds.
- Each tower increases population by 2.

- The illegal is still considered a peaceful player and no other peaceful player except the governor has the right to attack him.
- If the governor declares war on an illegal, the illegal receives the status of an occupant, while the peace status of the governor is preserved.
- By sending their units to the governor's monastery, the illegal can at any time regain the peaceful status of a refugee.

tags.balance_change: - Now each occupant reduces the overall mining productivity of the planet by 5%, illegal by 10%, tyrant by 15%. Productivity penalties are cumulative, the more occupiers and illegals, the lower the overall mining productivity of the planet. Everyone gets fined, including the violators themselves.
- The cost of the hub has been increased. In addition, the construction of a level 11 and higher hub now requires very rare resources: platinum, silicon, obsidian and diamonds.

tags.feature: - Each tower increases population by 2.

notes.title: April 30 update
notes.content:
- Now you can build a trading station at the spaceport.
- The trading station cannot be sent to another planet, it can only be placed into the orbit of the current planet.
- The market building and the trading station launched into orbit open access to the global market.
- The local market for each planet is different, and depending on the availability of resources, prices in local markets can vary greatly. There is only one global market, common to the entire universe.
- For one transaction, you can buy or sell 100 units resource in the local market, 1000 in the global.
- The transaction tax for the local market is 10%, for the global market it is two times lower, only 5%.
- When you buy a resource, the price of it increases slightly. Conversely, when you sell, the price decreases slightly. In the local market, the price changes by 10%, in the global market by only 2%.

notes.title: February 4 update.
notes.content:
A new unit Spy is available in the game:

- The Spy disguises himself as another player's worker and can freely pass his gate if they are in auto mode.
- In terms of characteristics and appearance, it almost does not differ from the worker, the only difference is that the spy does not have an ax.
- Just like a worker, a spy can build a campfire anywhere, even if there is no hub nearby.
- In addition, spies can attack peaceful players without declaring war, while the attacker does not receive the status of a criminal. However, spies themselves can also be attacked, even those belonging to a peaceful player, and this is not considered a crime.
- As long as the enemy spy is not revealed, your units will not automatically attack him, he will be displayed in green on the screen, as if it were your unit.
- As soon as the Spy attacks someone, his disguise is removed for 1 minute and his color turns red, even if his owner is a peaceful player.
- If you select a disguised spy, it also turns red.
- You can train a spy at the university.

notes.title: Update September 23rd.
notes.content:
The game has such a parameter as "mining productivity", which previously depended only on political status. Now, in order for the players not to mindlessly build up all the free space with mines and farms, additional rules are introduced for this parameter.

Initially, when you have just colonized a new planet and have not yet built any buildings, when your political status is still neutral and there are no criminal colonists on the planet yet, your mining productivity is 100%.

Too many mining buildings and too many populations complicate the overall logistics of the colony. Therefore, each new farm, mine, power station, oil derrick or house reduces the overall productivity by 0.5%.

Hubs, on the contrary, greatly simplify logistics, so each new hub increases productivity by 10%.

All other buildings except those listed above do not affect the productivity of mining.

The real income from mining buildings is obtained by multiplying the productivity by your total production. Mining productivity only affects mining buildings, it does not affect the rate of resource extraction by workers.

The old rules also remain as before, the governor of the planet receives a 20% productivity bonus, the tyrant 10% bonus. If there is someone on the planet other than you with the status of a criminal, you suffer a 10% penalty to productivity.

You can view your colony's mining productivity on the upper left information panel by opening the galaxy map.

- If multiple fence sections or multiple gates with different levels are selected, the "raise level" button only affects the section with the lowest level.
